note: All data is synthetic. Posts are anonymized samples from a clustered feed.

signals.theme: eCall connects but operator has no location

sample_posts.text: Car flipped on the motorway, eCall dialed automatically and the call went through, but the operator kept asking where I was. The system said it had no location. Terrifying.
Came out of a long tunnel, lost control, eCall triggered. Emergency line connected fine but they had zero coordinates for us. Had to describe landmarks while injured.
Why does the automatic crash call work but send 'location not available'? The dispatcher literally could not see where the accident happened.
Rollover after a tunnel. eCall placed the call, voice was clear, but no position was transmitted. Rescue took far longer than it should have.

signals.description: PSAP integration reports multiple eCall sessions arriving with latitude/longitude = NOT_AVAILABLE (0x7FFFFFFF) and position_trusted cleared. Voice path and MSD transport are healthy; only the position is absent. Correlates with severe crashes shortly after GNSS signal loss (tunnels, rollovers).
Requests adding a vehicle color field to the MSD payload to help responders visually identify vehicles. Unrelated to the location-missing issue; included to exercise signal filtering/triage.
